crossRefs.note: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that…
She arose, and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet…
But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was…
doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…

translations.web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
translations.bsb: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
translations.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
translations.asv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come unto me?
